t: The Smith & Locke 300mm gate bolt is a heavy-duty monkey tail bolt designed for secure gate fastening in agricultural, commercial and domestic settings. Manufactured from robust steel with a weather-resistant black powder-coated finish, it provides consistent performance in exposed outdoor conditions. The long 300mm bolt length offers increased reach and holding strength, making it suitable for taller or heavier wooden gates. Smooth sliding action ensures reliable operation, while included fixings support straightforward installation.
